basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 13 Assistant Registrar, Counsellor and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur is filling 13 posts in Level 10 of the Pay Matrix (₹56100-177500/- plus admissible allowances): 4 Assistant Registrar, 5 Counsellor and 4 Executive Officer, including backlog vacancies, open to Indian Nationals. Applications are online only, through www.iitkgp.ac.in >> Jobs >> Staff Opening, on or before 19 December 2026, under Advertisement No. R/16/2026 dated 19 November 2026.

application_fee.details: The fee is paid through the online portal (SBI Net Banking/Other Banks Net Banking/All Banks Credit Cards (Retail)/Rupay Debit Cards). The fee paid will not be refunded under any circumstances, nor can it be held in reserve for any other application, examination or selection.

age_limit.details: The crucial date for determining the age limit is the closing date of submission of online applications. | Post Age Limit Assistant Registrar Preferably 40 years Counsellor Preferably 35 years Executive Officer Preferably 35 years

how_to_apply: Go to www.iitkgp.ac.in >> Jobs >> Staff Opening and apply online on or before 19 December 2026.
Enter a correct and active e-mail address, because all correspondence from the Institute is by e-mail only.
Upload the certificates that apply to you (see the list below); shortlisting is done only on the documents uploaded with the online application.
Pay the application fee through the online portal.
Check every field before submitting: no change, correction or modification is allowed once the application is submitted.
Obtain a printout of the application form after successful submission; it is required at the time of document verification/test/interview.
No hard copy of the application is to be submitted. For problems during the online application, the notice gives the contact [email protected].
Reserved categories: latest Caste/Category certificate issued by the Competent Authority.

OBC (Non Creamy Layer): OBC(NCL) certificate clearly showing non-creamy layer status, issued on or after 01.04.2026 but not later than the last date of online applications; without it, the applicant is treated as unreserved.
EWS: Income and Assets certificate in the prescribed format, based on income of financial year 2025-2026, issued on or after 01.04.2026 but not later than the last date, valid for 2026-2027.
PwD: proof of disability mentioning the percentage of disability, issued by the Competent Authority.
Experience certificates on the organisation's letterhead, with date of issue, specific period of work, salary, and name, designation, signature and stamp of the issuing authority.

Persons serving in Government/Semi Government Organizations/Autonomous Bodies/Educational Institutions: No Objection Certificate (NOC) and Vigilance clearance while applying online, failing which these must be produced at the interview.
important_instructions: The Institute reserves the right to fill or not fill any of the advertised positions, and to reject any or all applications without assigning reasons. No interim enquiries will be entertained, and no correspondence will be entertained about the selection process. Canvassing in any manner would entail disqualification. The Institute will verify antecedents and documents at appointment or during service; service will be terminated if documents are fake or antecedents have been suppressed. Updates and amendments will appear at www.iitkgp.ac.in >> Jobs >> Staff Opening. Any dispute about the selection/recruitment process is subject to courts having jurisdiction over Kolkata.

content_sections.heading: IIT Kharagpur Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

rows.details: Level 10 of Pay Matrix ₹56100-177500/- plus admissible allowances as per Institute norms

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals may apply. Eligibility and any other shortlisting criteria are considered as on the last date of online application, 19 December 2026. The degree certificate should have been awarded by a recognized University/Institute. Essential Qualification: Master's Degree with at least 55% marks or its equivalent grade of 'B' in the UGC 7-point scale from recognised Universities/Institutes of repute and consistently good academic records. Essential Experience: At least 3 years of relevant experience at supervisory level at least in Level 6 of Pay Matrix ₹35400-112400/- (Pre-revised: PB-2, GP ₹4200/-) or equivalent in a reputed Educational Institute/University System/Research Institute/Central Government Departments; Experience in Computer System & Applications, Office Automation. Desirable: Experience / Exposure to computer based Finance & Accounting / Audit / Academic / Purchase & Stores / Establishment/Personnel & HR will be preferred. Essential Qualification & Experience: Masters degree in Psychology with specialization in clinical / social psychology with 2 years experience in psychological counselling in a Clinical, Medical or Academic institution of repute. OR M. Phil in Clinical Psychology with 1st class, along with at least 2 years of relevant experience. OR MA in Clinical Psychology with 1st Class along with 3 years of relevant experience. Relevant experience is defined as counseling experience for group counseling as well as individual counseling in an educational institution or in a mental health-care clinic. Desirable: M. Phil/ Ph.D. in psychology preferred; experience in psychological counselling of young adults living in a fully residential campus of an academic institution of repute. Essential Qualification: Bachelor's Degree in Engineering with 1st Class or equivalent OR Master's Degree in other than Engineering such as Arts/Science etc with a minimum 55% marks or its equivalent grade of 'B' in the UGC 7-point scale from a recognised University/Institute of repute. Essential Experience: At least three years of relevant working experience at supervisory level in a reputed organisation/institution in these areas: working and liasoning with students and / or corporate; handling career development processes at any organisation; handling large projects with multiple organisations; working experience in Personnel & HR department of any reputed organisation. Desirable: Preference will be given to candidates possessing MBA Degree. Competencies: Office planning and organising, building relationship with public and private sectors, team management, good working knowledge and understanding of data analysis, strong quantitative and analytical skills, effective verbal and written communication skills as well as proficiency in English. Hands on experience with Google applications, Microsoft applications including Share Point and other enterprise services, Web applications, online promotional and social media tools. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: All three posts carry Level 10 of Pay Matrix ₹56100-177500/- and other allowances as admissible as per the Institute norms. The notice does not mention the in-hand salary. The posts are advertised as regular posts, but the Institute reserves the right to offer a post on contract basis instead of a regular post, depending upon the qualification, experience and/or performance in the selection process.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid through the online portal (SBI Net Banking/Other Banks Net Banking/All Banks Credit Cards (Retail)/Rupay Debit Cards). The fee paid will not be refunded under any circumstances, nor can it be held in reserve for any other application, examination or selection.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Kharagpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to www.iitkgp.ac.in >> Jobs >> Staff Opening and apply online on or before 19 December 2026. Enter a correct and active e-mail address, because all correspondence from the Institute is by e-mail only. Upload the certificates that apply to you (see the list below); shortlisting is done only on the documents uploaded with the online application. Pay the application fee through the online portal. Check every field before submitting: no change, correction or modification is allowed once the application is submitted. Obtain a printout of the application form after successful submission; it is required at the time of document verification/test/interview. No hard copy of the application is to be submitted. For problems during the online application, the notice gives the contact [email protected] . Reserved categories: latest Caste/Category certificate issued by the Competent Authority. OBC (Non Creamy Layer): OBC(NCL) certificate clearly showing non-creamy layer status, issued on or after 01.04.2026 but not later than the last date of online applications; without it, the applicant is treated as unreserved. EWS: Income and Assets certificate in the prescribed format, based on income of financial year 2025-2026, issued on or after 01.04.2026 but not later than the last date, valid for 2026-2027. PwD: proof of disability mentioning the percentage of disability, issued by the Competent Authority. Experience certificates on the organisation's letterhead, with date of issue, specific period of work, salary, and name, designation, signature and stamp of the issuing authority. Persons serving in Government/Semi Government Organizations/Autonomous Bodies/Educational Institutions: No Objection Certificate (NOC) and Vigilance clearance while applying online, failing which these must be produced at the interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The Institute may call only the requisite number of candidates for the selection process after shortlisting with reference to qualification, suitability, experience, etc. If the number of applicants for a post is large, the Institute reserves the right to evolve a screening or selection process such as a Screening Test, Written Test, Presentation, Group Discussion or Personal Interview. The test/interview schedule will be e-mailed in due course to shortlisted candidates at their registered e-mail; no separate hard-copy letter will be sent. Admission to any stage is provisional, subject to confirmation of eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The Institute reserves the right to fill or not fill any of the advertised positions, and to reject any or all applications without assigning reasons. No interim enquiries will be entertained, and no correspondence will be entertained about the selection process. Canvassing in any manner would entail disqualification. The Institute will verify antecedents and documents at appointment or during service; service will be terminated if documents are fake or antecedents have been suppressed. Updates and amendments will appear at www.iitkgp.ac.in >> Jobs >> Staff Opening. Any dispute about the selection/recruitment process is subject to courts having jurisdiction over Kolkata.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT Kharagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 13 vacancies: 4 Assistant Registrar, 5 Counsellor and 4 Executive Officer, including backlog vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online application must be submitted on or before 19 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Assistant Registrar post?
faq.answer: A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks or grade 'B' in the UGC 7-point scale, plus at least 3 years of relevant supervisory experience at least in Level 6 of Pay Matrix or equivalent.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Preferably 40 years for Assistant Registrar and preferably 35 years for Counsellor and Executive Officer, counted on the closing date of online applications, with relaxation as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: All three posts are in Level 10 of Pay Matrix ₹56100-177500/- plus allowances as admissible.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: Rs. 500/- for SC/ST/PwD/Women candidates and Rs. 1000/- for others, paid online and not refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online through www.iitkgp.ac.in >> Jobs >> Staff Opening by 19 December 2026; no hard copy of the application is to be sent.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted on qualification, suitability and experience, and the Institute may hold a Screening Test, Written Test, Presentation, Group Discussion or Personal Interview if applicants are many.

faq.question: Q9. Is the job permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The posts are regular, but the Institute reserves the right to offer a post on contract basis depending on qualification, experience and/or performance in selection.

faq.question: Q10. Can women get age relaxation?
faq.answer: Yes, women candidates may also be allowed a relaxation of the upper age limit to encourage their participation in the Institute.
